title: Confirm no PLUGINS_DROPPED in sync-all-safe.log on both Macs, then close the enabledPlugins drop investigation
notes: The dotfiles auto-sync `d554437` (and `9831be7` on the Mac mini) committed a
settings file whose `enabledPlugins` lacked `atrium-context@atrium`, so Claude
Code ran with no per-prompt retrieval and no footer for 19 days, and nothing
reported it. Re-installed on both Macs 2026-11-06 (claude-config `78e7848`);
`atrium doctor` warns since `14d85ac`. Left: find what rewrote `enabledPlugins`
on 2026-10-18 (the same diff dropped `ponytail` and `taste-skill`; suspect the
settings ping-pong fixed in `9656692`). `ponytail` and `taste-skill` were
re-enabled on both Macs (claude-config `d21be96`); the Mac mini's config repo
had sat in an unresolved auto-sync merge since 2026-11-05 20:00, over
`.skillkit.json` timestamps only, resolved in `b059867`.
**2026-11-08: dropped again** by the Mac mini auto-sync `81ac524`
(2026-11-07 20:00), same three plugins, together with `defaultMode` and a
`playwright` toggle: a rewrite of the whole file from a copy predating
`78e7848`, which points at a long-running Claude Code process on the mini
writing back its in-memory settings (unverified). Re-enabled (claude-config).
The session-start hook now says so in every Claude Code session, to the
person (`per-prompt retrieval OFF` in the start line) and to the model (run
`atrium context` yourself), via `hooks/claude-code/prompt_retrieval_missing.py`,
which reuses the doctor's predicate. Cause found the same day: the three
plugins were never installed on the mini (`installed_plugins.json` is per
machine and untracked; the 2026-11-06 re-install only fixed settings), and
each time a settings rewrite there lost exactly those three. Installed on
the mini with `claude plugin install`; dotfiles `73bec09` makes
sync-all-safe restore any `enabledPlugins` entry HEAD has and the working
copy lost before it commits claude-config, with a `PLUGINS_DROPPED` PROBLEM
notification (turn a plugin off with `false`, never by deleting the entry).
Left: whether Claude Code itself prunes uninstalled plugins on write is
unproven; close this after a week with no `PLUGINS_DROPPED` in
`~/.local/state/sync-all-safe.log` on either Mac.

2026-11-24 audit: verified on this Mac: settings.json has atrium-context@atrium true, installed_plugins.json lists it, dotfiles 73bec09 (2026-11-08) exists, prompt_retrieval_missing.py hook present (de2174f), and ~/.local/state/sync-all-safe.log has 0 PLUGINS_DROPPED lines (16 days since the fix, over the one-week bar). Not verified: the Mac mini log (other machine). Left: read the mini sync-all-safe.log for PLUGINS_DROPPED; if none, close (root cause of the 2026-10-18 rewrite stays unproven). Smallest next step: ssh to the mini and grep the log.
